prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, inside a deep 1930s brick bank vault, close on a fat gangster with a scar through his top lip in pinstripe trousers, a waistcoat and rolled shirt-sleeves, pushing a wheelbarrow heaped with bundles of blank green paper money with no printing, each tied with a rubber band, up a wooden plank: his real-skinned face large in frame and off-centre left, red, sweat running, teeth gritted, a cigar stub in the corner of his mouth. Behind him, soft, the mountain of bundles rising to the ceiling under caged bulbs, and the orange glow of an open furnace door. Most of the frame in deep shadow; the brightest values are the bulb light on his wet face and the bundles. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
